FunnelStepTracker.luau.description: Funnel Step Tracker provides the class/model implementation used by the Funnels package. Public entry points include `FunnelStepTracker.new`, `FunnelStepTracker.LogStep`, `FunnelStepTracker.IsStepComplete`, `FunnelStepTracker.GetLoggedSteps`, `FunnelStepTracker.ClearLoggedSteps`.
